title: E-FRC-0111: the triality weave passes the rest of the acceptance battery asked in a form that does not assume a...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0111 in the gauge arena: the triality weave passes the rest of the acceptance battery asked in a form that does not assume a protected species: its vacuum recurs exactly from birth, separated disturbances superpose exactly, walls are sheet-quantized, and its dressing grows no faster than the committed turning weave's, while its wall is not localized: the defect against the piecewise vacuum fills the box at sides 9, 13 and 17 (by beat 57 at side 17, where the committed rule fills it by beat 6).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
